title: Casa Blanca Golf Course Open Thanksgiving Morning, Last Tee Time at Noon
excerpt: Webb County announced Tuesday that Casa Blanca Golf Course will be open on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, from 8 a.m. to noon, with the last tee time at noon.
content:
Webb County announced Tuesday that Casa Blanca Golf Course will be open on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon.

The last tee time is 12:00 noon, and all golf carts must be in before 4:30 p.m.

The holiday hours were posted to the county's Facebook page on Tuesday, Nov. 24.
